انسحبوا (form VII)
# اِنْسَحَبُوا (insaḥabū) /in.sa.ħa.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْسَحَبَ (insaḥaba)
# اِنْسَحِبُوا (insaḥibū) /in.sa.ħi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْسَحَبَ (insaḥaba)
